deposit_refund_extended.title: Deposit refund timelines
deposit_refund_extended.note: Related: Model Tenancy Act, 2021 — security deposit caps and refund expectations (typically timely return after deductions). Informational reference only.

notice_period_extended.title: Notice / termination periods
notice_period_extended.note: Related: Model Tenancy Act provisions on notice for termination of tenancy. Longer notice can constrain exit flexibility. Informational reference only.

auto_renewal_introduced.title: Auto-renewal
auto_renewal_introduced.note: Related: Consumer Protection Act principles on unfair contract terms; auto-renewal should be transparent with a workable opt-out. Informational reference only.
refs: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (unfair terms — general principles)

auto_renewal_notice_extended.title: Auto-renewal cancellation window
auto_renewal_notice_extended.note: Related: Unfair-term scrutiny when cancellation windows become impractical. Informational reference only.

payment_commission_reduced.title: Payment / commission cuts
payment_commission_reduced.note: Related: Platform worker terms — sudden commission cuts may engage contract and consumer-fairness questions. Informational reference only.

fee_increased.title: Fee increases
fee_increased.note: Related: Transparent fee disclosure expectations under consumer protection norms. Informational reference only.

rent_increased.title: Rent increases
rent_increased.note: Related: Model Tenancy Act guidance on rent revision mechanisms agreed in the agreement. Informational reference only.

liability_shifted.title: Liability / indemnity shifts
liability_shifted.note: Related: Over-broad indemnity and liability waivers can be contested as unfair in some consumer contexts. Informational reference only.

maintenance_shifted.title: Maintenance obligations
maintenance_shifted.note: Related: Model Tenancy Act allocates structural vs day-to-day repair duties between landlord and tenant. Informational reference only.

arbitration_introduced.title: Arbitration clauses
arbitration_introduced.note: Related: Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996 — arbitration can limit ordinary civil-court routes. Informational reference only.

unilateral_amendment.title: Unilateral amendments
unilateral_amendment.note: Related: One-sided amendment rights may raise unfair-term concerns for consumers/workers. Informational reference only.

data_rights_expanded.title: Personal data use
data_rights_expanded.note: Related: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 — purpose limitation and consent principles. Informational reference only.

protection_removed.title: Removed protections
protection_removed.note: Related: Removal of refund/grievance protections can worsen bargaining position — compare against the signed baseline. Informational reference only.

clause_removed.title: Removed clause
clause_removed.note: Related: Confirm whether the removed clause was a negotiated protection. Informational reference only.

material_wording_change.title: Wording change
material_wording_change.note: Related: Even small wording shifts can alter obligations — compare side by side. Informational reference only.
